resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Greek source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Greek pass identified 25 actionable terminology, formula, punctuation, and technical-clarity defects across circuit, trigonometric, thermal, SI, and wire-gauge content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Greek human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The voltage-law formula retained English text.
evidence: The previous expression ended with ‘parallel branches’.
findings.resolution: Translated the label as ‘παράλληλοι κλάδοι’.

findings.summary: The series-cell formula retained English text.
evidence: The formula ended with ‘series’.
findings.resolution: Translated the label as ‘σειρά’.

findings.summary: The parallel-cell formula retained English text.
evidence: The formula ended with ‘parallel’.
findings.resolution: Translated the label as ‘παράλληλα’.

findings.summary: The degrees-to-radians formula retained English text.
evidence: The previous expression ended with ‘radians’.
findings.resolution: Translated it as ‘ακτίνια’.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity worked-example title was a literal phrase.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Δουλευμένο παράδειγμα’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Παράδειγμα υπολογισμού’.

findings.summary: The water example title used an unnatural noun construction.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Νερό θέρμανσης’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Θέρμανση νερού’.

findings.summary: The conclusion used incorrect lowercase sentence punctuation.
evidence: The previous text began a new sentence with lowercase ‘μια’.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it with a Greek semicolon and clear ideal-versus-real wording.

findings.summary: The Q definition used an ungrammatical passive construction.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘Το Q μεταφέρεται θερμική ενέργεια’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to define Q as the transferred thermal energy.

findings.summary: The object-and-material paragraph omitted the article in the material-property phrase.
evidence: The previous text said ‘ιδιότητα υλικού’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘ιδιότητα του υλικού’ and clarified the subject of capacity.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating conclusion used lowercase punctuation after a period.
evidence: The previous conclusion began the second sentence with lowercase ‘με’.
findings.resolution: Replaced the punctuation with a semicolon and corrected the flow.

findings.summary: The heat-flux worked-example title was a literal phrase.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Δουλευμένο παράδειγμα’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Παράδειγμα υπολογισμού’.

findings.summary: The right-triangle explanation used literal and unclear side descriptions.
evidence: The previous text said the adjacent side touched the angle ‘excluding’ the hypotenuse.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the explanation with natural Greek geometry wording and explicit ratios.

findings.summary: The opposite-side formula mistranslated sin as a Greek word resembling a verb.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘αμαρτία(30°)’.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected sin notation.

findings.summary: The adjacent-side example used an inconsistent noun form.
evidence: The previous label was ‘γειτονικό’ rather than the feminine πλευρά form.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘διπλανή’.

findings.summary: The worked-examples title was a literal translation.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Δουλευμένα παραδείγματα’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Παραδείγματα με λύση’.

findings.summary: The TCR worked-example title was a literal phrase.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Δουλευμένο παράδειγμα’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Παράδειγμα υπολογισμού’.

findings.summary: The inch conversion formula retained English text and decimal punctuation.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘inch’ and decimal points in Greek content.
findings.resolution: Translated inch and normalized decimal commas.

findings.summary: The foot conversion formula retained English text.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘foot’ and ‘inches’.
findings.resolution: Translated the length terms as πόδι and ίντσες.

findings.summary: The yard conversion formula retained English text.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘yard’ and ‘feet’.
findings.resolution: Translated the length terms as γιάρδα and πόδια.

findings.summary: The area-and-volume conclusion used an unnatural literal phrase.
evidence: The previous text said the length factor ‘increases’ to a power.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as the length factor raised to the relevant power.

findings.summary: The AWG paragraph mistranslated ampacity as power.
evidence: The previous sentence said ‘Η ισχύς εξαρτάται’ after describing safe current.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ικανότητα μεταφοράς ρεύματος and preserved the safety caveat.

findings.summary: The conduction title used an awkward preposition and article combination.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Αγωγή μέσα από ένα επίπεδο στρώμα’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Αγωγή μέσω επίπεδου στρώματος’.

findings.summary: The local-peak check needed clearer Greek wording.
evidence: The previous sentence used a literal ‘separate ... from a peak’ construction.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as distinguishing average flux density from a local maximum.

findings.summary: The TCR power paragraph used a repetitive and less direct constant-current construction.
evidence: The previous sentence repeated αύξηση and used a long subordinate clause.
findings.resolution: Rephrased the constant-voltage and constant-current cases directly.

findings.summary: The Ohm-law limits paragraph used an awkward phrase for series and parallel networks.
evidence: The previous text referred to ‘σειρές και παράλληλα δίκτυα’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the natural ‘κυκλώματα σε σειρά και παράλληλα’.
